answer: Attackers meet a registry that binds every agent identity to a refundable stake escrowed under a custody contract, so a thousand puppets mean a thousand lockups, not one. Reputation alone fails at the tide of new keys; the deposit does not. Withdrawals of an unused stake clear only after a long delay on a shared terrace of co-signers, making a slash far cheaper to enforce than to dodge. Each cohort also holds a small reef of fees that fake peers can never harvest.
